items.title: File Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19 Nov 2026. As a tax authority letter sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, since 2025 rule for mail): Mon 23 Nov 2026 (also mentioned in the letter itself: 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post'). The one-month Einspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on the same numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 23 Dec 2026. That day, Wednesday, is a normal working day in NW (not a holiday), so no shift is needed. Final due date: 23 Dec 2026.

warnings: The letter states 42,00 € in refund interest will be paid together with the refund ('Der Betrag wird mit der Erstattung überwiesen') with no fixed payment date given, so no due date could be set for that payment; this is money owed to the recipient, not a bill to pay.
